examples.en: The disease is caused by genetic mutations.
examples.zh: 这种疾病由基因突变引起。

examples.en: This essay examines the mutation of ethnic politics into nationalist politics.
examples.zh: 这篇文章考察了族群政治向民族主义政治的转变。

examples.en: The child sat mute in the corner of the room.
examples.zh: 孩子一声不吭地坐在房间角落里。

meanings: 缓和（mute 的第三人称单数）

examples.en: They parted by mutual consent.
examples.zh: 双方同意分手。

examples.en: We met at the home of a mutual friend.
examples.zh: 我们在一位共同朋友家相识。

examples.en: Her book presents him as a case study in narcissism.
examples.zh: 她的书把他作为自恋的个案研究。

examples.en: There are always naysayers who claim the plan won't work.
examples.zh: 总有人唱反调，声称计划不会成功。

examples.en: Increased traffic necessitated widening the road.
examples.zh: 交通量增加使拓宽道路成为必要。

examples.en: It’s a charity that provides help and comfort for needy children.
examples.zh: 这是一个为贫困儿童提供帮助和慰藉的慈善机构。

examples.en: She is shy and needy.
examples.zh: 她很害羞，渴望情感支持。

examples.en: The terms of employment are negotiable.
examples.zh: 雇用条件可以协商。

examples.en: The site gives neophytes the chance to learn from experts.
examples.zh: 该网站让新手有机会向专家学习。

examples.en: The disease can also cause nerve damage.
examples.zh: 此病还可能损伤神经。

examples.en: It took a lot of nerve to take the company to court.
examples.zh: 将公司告上法庭需要极大勇气。

examples.en: Switzerland was neutral during the war.
examples.zh: 瑞士在战争期间保持中立。

examples.en: ‘So you told her?’ he said in a neutral tone of voice.
examples.zh: “那么你告诉她了？”他用不带倾向的语气说道。

examples.en: I'm afraid we cannot guarantee the neutrality of the courts.
examples.zh: 恐怕我们无法保证法院的中立性。

examples.en: Switzerland declared its neutrality.
examples.zh: 瑞士宣布保持中立、不参战。

meanings: 新式而令人不以为然的

examples.en: You need nimble fingers for that job.
examples.zh: 做那工作需要灵巧的手指。

examples.en: As a comedian, she has a quick ear and a nimble mind.
examples.zh: 作为喜剧演员，她听觉敏锐，头脑机灵。

examples.en: The region is becoming a nirvana for investing.
examples.zh: 该地区正成为投资的理想之地。

examples.en: He remained in nominal control of the business for another ten years.
examples.zh: 他又在名义上掌控这家企业十年。

examples.en: We only pay a nominal rent.
examples.zh: 我们只支付象征性的租金。

examples.en: ‘It'll be fine,’ she replied, with a nonchalant shrug.
examples.zh: “会没事的，”她若无其事地耸耸肩答道。

examples.en: That’s a nonsensical argument.
examples.zh: 那是个荒谬的论点。

examples.en: I have to reject the notion that greed can be a good thing.
examples.zh: 我必须反对贪婪可能是好事这种观念。

examples.en: The country is notorious for its appalling prison conditions.
examples.zh: 该国因骇人的监狱条件而臭名昭著。

examples.en: Can plants obtain adequate nourishment from such poor soil?
examples.zh: 植物能从这样贫瘠的土壤中获得足够营养吗？

examples.en: As a child, she was starved of intellectual nourishment.
examples.zh: 她小时候缺乏知识的滋养。

examples.en: I'm a complete novice at skiing.
examples.zh: 我滑雪完全是新手。

examples.en: Judges were unwilling to nullify government decisions.
examples.zh: 法官们不愿宣布政府决定无效。

examples.en: An unhealthy diet will nullify the effects of training.
examples.zh: 不健康的饮食会抵消训练效果。

examples.en: Students were asked to write in numerals a number that was presented in words.
examples.zh: 学生被要求将用文字表示的数写成数字。

meanings: 神秘灵性的、超自然的、令人感到神圣存在的

examples.en: The general commands absolute obeisance.
examples.zh: 这位将军要求绝对服从。

examples.en: He is a master of obfuscation.
examples.zh: 他是故弄玄虚的高手。

examples.en: These classes are obligatory for all first-year students.
examples.zh: 所有一年级学生都必须上这些课。

examples.en: In the mid-60s he took the almost obligatory trip to India.
examples.zh: 六十年代中期，他按当时几乎人人照做的惯例去了一趟印度。

examples.en: I find her really obnoxious.
examples.zh: 我觉得她真令人讨厌。

examples.en: The origins of the tradition have become obscure.
examples.zh: 这一传统的起源已经变得模糊不清。

examples.en: I found her lecture very obscure.
examples.zh: 我觉得她的讲座很难懂。

examples.en: We went to see one of Shakespeare’s more obscure plays.
examples.zh: 我们去看了莎士比亚一部较少为人知的戏剧。

examples.en: Most information was collected by direct observation of the animals' behaviour.
examples.zh: 大多数信息是通过直接观察动物行为收集的。

examples.en: She has some interesting observations on possible future developments.
examples.zh: 她对未来可能的发展提出了一些有趣的看法。

meanings: 阻碍进步或达成目标的事物

examples.en: This huge open ditch forms the biggest obstacle on the course.
examples.zh: 这条巨大的明沟构成了赛道上最大的障碍。

examples.en: A lack of qualifications can be a major obstacle to finding a job.
examples.zh: 缺少资历可能成为求职的一大障碍。

examples.en: He can be very obstinate when he wants to be!
examples.zh: 他想固执起来时会非常固执！

meanings: 顽抗控制的，不服管束的

examples.en: You can't park here, you're obstructing my driveway.
examples.zh: 你不能把车停在这里，你挡住我的车道了。

examples.en: The pillar obstructed our view of the stage.
examples.zh: 柱子挡住了我们看舞台的视线。

examples.en: The design should not obtrude to the extent that it distracts the reader.
examples.zh: 设计不应显眼到分散读者注意力的程度。

meanings: 突兀碍眼的，过分显眼的

examples.en: The sofa would be less obtrusive in a paler colour.
examples.zh: 如果颜色淡一点，这沙发就不会那么扎眼了。

items.notes: 候选句中的 presence was not too obtrusive 主要说明不太引人注意，未用于现有“冒失打扰人的”义项。

examples.en: Disaster was obviated by the opening of the reserve parachute.
examples.zh: 备用降落伞的打开避免了灾难。

examples.en: We expect you to dress for the occasion.
examples.zh: 我们希望你穿得符合这个场合。

examples.en: I've met him on several occasions.
examples.zh: 我见过他好几次。

examples.en: Her death was the occasion of mass riots.
examples.zh: 她的死引发了大规模骚乱。

examples.en: He's interested in witchcraft and the occult.
examples.zh: 他对巫术和神秘学感兴趣。

examples.en: What an odious man!
examples.zh: 真是个可憎的人！

examples.en: Some of his remarks were very off-key.
examples.zh: 他的一些话很不合时宜。

examples.en: I find his manner very off-putting.
examples.zh: 我觉得他的态度很令人反感。

examples.en: Prices have risen in order to offset the increased cost of materials.
examples.zh: 价格已经上涨，以抵消材料成本的增加。

examples.en: The daily newspaper and its various offshoots have only 25 journalists between them.
examples.zh: 这份日报及其各个分支总共只有二十五名记者。

examples.en: The jazz club always has a good mixture of old-timers and new faces.
examples.zh: 这个爵士乐俱乐部总有老成员和新面孔相聚，搭配得很好。

examples.en: There were ominous dark clouds gathering overhead.
examples.zh: 不祥的乌云正在头顶聚集。

examples.en: These days the media are omnipresent.
examples.zh: 如今媒体无处不在。

examples.en: Blood oozed out of the wound.
examples.zh: 血从伤口慢慢渗出。

examples.en: She walked into the party oozing confidence.
examples.zh: 她走进聚会场所，浑身洋溢着自信。

examples.en: The jargon in his talk was opaque to me.
examples.zh: 他讲话中的行话让我难以理解。

examples.en: I’ve never met anyone so arrogant and opinionated.
examples.zh: 我从未见过如此傲慢又固执己见的人。

examples.en: The political situation has grown increasingly oppressive.
examples.zh: 政治形势已经变得越来越压迫人。

examples.en: The silence between them started to grow oppressive.
examples.zh: 两人之间的沉默开始令人压抑。

meanings: 因恶劣行为招致的恶名或耻辱

examples.en: The bombing has attracted international opprobrium.
examples.zh: 这次轰炸遭到国际社会的谴责。

examples.en: He was ordained (as) a priest last year.
examples.zh: 他去年被授予神父圣职。

examples.en: Fate had ordained that they would never meet again.
examples.zh: 命运注定他们再也不会见面。

examples.en: The mountaineers found it hard to orientate themselves in the fog.
examples.zh: 登山者发现很难在雾中辨明方向。

examples.en: It took him some time to orientate himself in his new school.
examples.zh: 他花了一些时间才熟悉新学校的环境。

examples.en: The orientation of the planet's orbit is changing continuously.
examples.zh: 这颗行星轨道的朝向在不断变化。

examples.en: The course is essentially theoretical in orientation.
examples.zh: 这门课程基本上以理论为导向。

examples.en: There were a few china ornaments on the shelf above the fireplace.
examples.zh: 壁炉上方的架子上摆着几件瓷制装饰品。

examples.en: The building is an ornament to the city.
examples.zh: 这座建筑为城市增光添彩。

examples.en: The chimney pots are purely ornamental.
examples.zh: 这些烟囱管帽纯粹是装饰用的。

meanings: 使思想或制度僵化、变得守旧

examples.en: The ostensible reason for his absence was illness.
examples.zh: 他声称缺席的原因是生病。

meanings: 过分铺张以引人注目的

examples.en: He gave an ostentatious yawn.
examples.zh: 他故意夸张地打了个哈欠。

meanings: 驱逐，剥夺职位或占有权

examples.en: He was ousted as chairman.
examples.zh: 他被赶下了主席的位置。

examples.en: There was outcry at the judge's statement.
examples.zh: 法官的言论引起了强烈抗议。

examples.en: The brothers tried to outdo each other in everything.
examples.zh: 兄弟俩事事都想胜过对方。

examples.en: As the show progressed, it got ever more outlandish.
examples.zh: 随着演出进行，节目变得越来越离奇。

examples.en: He can outlast anyone on the dance floor.
examples.zh: 他在舞池里能比任何人跳得都久。

meanings: 在数量上超过，比……人数更多

examples.en: The demonstrators were heavily outnumbered by the police.
examples.zh: 警察的人数远远超过示威者。

examples.en: No one has yet claimed responsibility for this latest terrorist outrage.
examples.zh: 尚未有人宣称对这次最新的恐怖暴行负责。

examples.en: The judge's remarks caused public outrage.
examples.zh: 法官的言论引起了公众愤慨。

examples.en: She was the outright winner.
examples.zh: 她是毫无争议的胜者。

examples.en: You should have made that clear right at the outset.
examples.zh: 你本来就应该一开始把那件事说清楚。

examples.en: She found him rude and overbearing.
examples.zh: 她觉得他粗鲁而且盛气凌人。

meanings: 使承担超出能力的负担

examples.en: They should not overextend themselves on the mortgage.
examples.zh: 他们不该为住房抵押贷款承担超出自身能力的负担。

examples.en: Timber-framed houses overhang the narrow streets.
examples.zh: 木框架房屋的上层突出在狭窄街道上方。

examples.en: A radical overhaul of the tax system is necessary.
examples.zh: 有必要对税制进行根本改革。

examples.en: A fish’s scales overlap each other.
examples.zh: 鱼鳞相互重叠。

examples.en: Our jobs overlap slightly, which sometimes causes difficulties.
examples.zh: 我们的工作略有交叉，这有时会造成困难。

examples.en: He seems to have overlooked one important fact.
examples.zh: 他似乎忽略了一个重要事实。

examples.en: Our back yard is overlooked by several houses.
examples.zh: 从几栋房子里可以俯瞰我们的后院。

examples.en: I was prepared to overlook her mistakes this time.
examples.zh: 这一次我准备不计较她的错误。

examples.en: The chairman overrode the committee's objections and signed the agreement.
examples.zh: 主席不顾委员会的反对，签署了协议。

examples.en: Considerations of safety override all other concerns.
examples.zh: 安全方面的考虑优先于其他一切顾虑。

examples.en: He had always been overshadowed by his elder sister.
examples.zh: 他一直在姐姐的光芒下显得黯然失色。

examples.en: News of the accident overshadowed the day's events.
examples.zh: 事故的消息给当天的活动蒙上了阴影。

examples.en: The garden is overshadowed by tall trees.
examples.zh: 花园被高大的树木遮蔽着。

meanings: 夸大（事实、作用、重要性等）

examples.en: Her musical talent has been a little overstated.
examples.zh: 她的音乐天赋被稍稍夸大了。

examples.en: There was little overt support for the project.
examples.zh: 对这个项目的公开支持很少。

examples.en: The president was overthrown in a military coup.
examples.zh: 总统在一次军事政变中被推翻。

meanings: 爱好和平的，息事宁人的
费心细致的，辛勤周到的

examples.en: The event had been planned with painstaking attention to detail.
examples.zh: 这项活动经过了对细节一丝不苟的策划。

examples.en: Hospitals must serve palatable and healthy food.
examples.zh: 医院必须供应可口而健康的食物。

examples.en: Some of the dialogue has been changed to make it more palatable to an American audience.
examples.zh: 一些对白经过改动，以便让美国观众更容易接受。

examples.en: The tension in the room was almost palpable.
examples.zh: 房间里的紧张气氛几乎可以触摸到。

examples.en: His statement is palpable nonsense.
examples.zh: 他的话显然是胡说八道。

examples.en: There is no single panacea for the problem of unemployment.
examples.zh: 不存在能够解决失业问题的单一万能办法。

examples.en: She carried off the performance with panache.
examples.zh: 她以潇洒自如的气派完成了表演。

examples.en: Pandemonium broke out when the news was announced.
examples.zh: 消息宣布后，现场一片混乱。

examples.en: The government has promised a whole panoply of social and economic improvements.
examples.zh: 政府承诺进行一系列丰富多样的社会和经济改善。

examples.en: She finished the race panting heavily.
examples.zh: 她跑完比赛后大口喘气。

examples.en: She has won her place in the pantheon of popular culture.
examples.zh: 她在大众文化的杰出人物之列赢得了一席之地。

examples.en: The war was a paradigm of the destructive side of human nature.
examples.zh: 这场战争是人性破坏性一面的典型例子。

examples.en: Silicon Valley is the paradigmatic example of the new US economy, which relies on high-tech industries for growth.
examples.zh: 硅谷是美国新经济的典型范例，这种经济依靠高科技产业实现增长。

examples.en: I make no claim to be a paragon.
examples.zh: 我并不自称模范。

examples.en: Safety is paramount.
examples.zh: 安全是最重要的。

examples.en: The trial was a parody of justice.
examples.zh: 这次审判是对正义的拙劣模仿。

examples.en: They blamed the ailing state education system on a series of parsimonious governments.
examples.zh: 他们把国家教育体系的困境归咎于一届又一届吝啬的政府。

examples.en: They preferred not to partake in the social life of the town.
examples.zh: 他们宁愿不参与镇上的社交生活。

examples.en: Would you care to partake of some refreshment?
examples.zh: 您愿意吃点喝点吗？

examples.en: She has a partiality for exotic flowers.
examples.zh: 她偏爱异国花卉。

examples.en: Participatory democracy is a fundamental principle of cooperative businesses.
examples.zh: 参与式民主是合作制企业的一项基本原则。

examples.en: In ‘She tore up the letter’, the word ‘up’ is a particle.
examples.zh: 在“She tore up the letter”中，“up”这个词是小品词。

examples.en: Most newspapers are politically partisan.
examples.zh: 多数报纸在政治上都有党派倾向。

meanings: 骤然发迹却未获上层认可的人

examples.en: He played a passive role in the relationship.
examples.zh: 他在这段关系中扮演被动的角色。

examples.en: From the plane, the landscape was just a patchwork of fields.
examples.zh: 从飞机上看，地面景观就是一块块田地拼接而成的图案。

meanings: 差劲得可悲的，荒唐可笑的

examples.en: The starving children were a pathetic sight.
examples.zh: 那些挨饿的孩子看上去令人怜悯。

examples.en: You're pathetic!
examples.zh: 你真差劲！

meanings: 使人怜悯、同情的感染力

examples.en: The scene was full of pathos.
examples.zh: 这一场景充满了令人悲悯的感染力。

meanings: 男性主导的社会或制度

examples.en: He feared that his patrimony would not be enough to cover the debts.
examples.zh: 他担心继承的财产不足以偿还债务。

examples.en: The agency is responsible for conserving the country’s cultural patrimony.
examples.zh: 该机构负责保护这个国家的文化遗产。

examples.en: Frederick the Great was the patron of many artists.
examples.zh: 腓特烈大帝是许多艺术家的赞助人。

examples.en: The car park is for the use of patrons only.
examples.zh: 这个停车场仅供顾客使用。

examples.en: Patronage of the arts comes from businesses and private individuals.
examples.zh: 艺术赞助来自企业和个人。

examples.en: Recruits are selected on merit, not through political patronage.
examples.zh: 新成员按才干选拔，而不是靠政治关系得到职位。

meanings: 以居高临下的态度对待

examples.en: Some television programmes tend to patronize children.
examples.zh: 一些电视节目往往以居高临下的态度对待儿童。

examples.en: She patronizes many contemporary British artists.
examples.zh: 她赞助了许多英国当代艺术家。

examples.en: The club is patronized by students and locals alike.
examples.zh: 学生和当地居民都会光顾这家俱乐部。

examples.en: The writer confessed to a few peccadilloes.
examples.zh: 这位作家承认自己有一些小过失。

examples.en: The meat tasted rather peculiar.
examples.zh: 这肉尝起来相当古怪。

examples.en: He has his own peculiar style which you'll soon get used to.
examples.zh: 他有自己独特的风格，你很快就会习惯的。

examples.en: A sharp ringing in the ears is a peculiarity of the disease.
examples.zh: 尖锐的耳鸣是这种疾病的一个特点。

examples.en: He was strongly attracted by her peculiarities of dress and behaviour.
examples.zh: 她在穿着和举止上的古怪之处深深吸引了他。

examples.en: These plants are peculiarly prone to disease.
examples.zh: 这些植物特别容易生病。

examples.en: He seemed to believe that it was a peculiarly British problem.
examples.zh: 他似乎相信这是英国所独有的问题。

examples.en: He worked as a door-to-door salesman peddling cloths and brushes.
examples.zh: 他做过挨家挨户推销抹布和刷子的推销员。

meanings: 兜售或传播某种东西的人

examples.en: Two pedestrians were injured when the car skidded.
examples.zh: 汽车打滑时撞伤了两名行人。

examples.en: She was proud of her long pedigree.
examples.zh: 她为自己源远流长的家系感到骄傲。

examples.en: The product has a pedigree going back to the last century.
examples.zh: 这个产品的渊源可以追溯到上个世纪。

examples.en: The light was so pellucid, so dazzling that she reached for her sunglasses.
examples.zh: 光线如此清澈、如此耀眼，以至于她伸手去拿太阳镜。

meanings: 作为弥补的惩罚或苦行

examples.en: She kneeled at her mother's feet in penance.
examples.zh: 她跪在母亲脚下忏悔赎罪。

review_method: 逐词核对已抓取的 Oxford 释义与原例句候选，按具体词性和义项选取完整句并自译；未取用的义项保持 null，不声称已经穷尽原站所有页面或来源。
